All retrieved context must be enclosed in clear untrusted data delimiters (e.g. `<context>...</context>`). 3. Prompts must explicitly instruct models to abstain ("I do not have sufficient information") rather than fabricate unverified claims. [Enterprise LLM Prompt Engineering & Versioning Standards, Prompt Engineering & System Instructions > Rules for AI Prompt Authoring]
